notes.title: The KANKA Website Is Now Live – Follow the Project in Early Development!
notes.content:
Hello friends! 👋

We’ve just launched our official website: kanka.gg

KANKA is a sci-fi third-person shooter Action RPG, currently in early development. Built by a father & son team, it's all about tight co-op action, tactical class-based gameplay, and exploring alien worlds with your “Kankas” (buddies).

The journey is just starting — and your voice matters.
🛠️ Follow our dev logs
💬 Join discussions
🎯 Help shape the experience

Check out the new site and let us know what you think!

👨‍👦 A true #FatherAndSonProject — game development done together, from the heart.
